typography.rules: No typography changes. Preserve all saved font sizes, line heights, and text alignments upon save and republish. Maintain separation between text content DOM nodes and icon DOM nodes.

colors.rules: No color changes. Retain all original palette definitions and CSS variables.

layout_and_spacing.the_ambition_section: Reduce excessive whitespace following 'The Ambition' block and preceding the page footer. Section margins and padding must align cleanly with adjacent grid containers.
layout_and_spacing.footer_alignment: Align footer edges with main content boundaries. Ensure adjustable section height and spacing via live CSS variable or configurable block parameters.
layout_and_spacing.contact_section_cta: The 'Get in touch' link/button and arrow icon must be wrapped in a single unified component container so text and arrow translate/move together as one unit.

button_arrow_grouping.behavior: Unified editable link/button. Arrow icon and label text must be housed within a shared parent wrapper element.
button_arrow_grouping.dom_structure: Outer interactive container holds text node and SVG icon node together. Text edits target the text child without stripping or duplicating the icon node.

republish_state_preservation.rule: Ensure typography classes, inline styles (fontSize, textAlign, letterSpacing), and inline positions are retained through republish actions without default resets.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements, buttons, editable text inputs, block adjustment controls, and footer links must include unambiguous data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Maintain strict scope. Do not alter existing branding, font families, or color tokens. Ensure the button label and arrow icon in 'Get in touch' move together seamlessly, retain font size and alignment choices upon republishing, reduce excess padding after 'The Ambition' before footer, and add data-testid attributes to key elements.
